text: Drink a glass of water with me 💧
Take three slow breaths. I'll do them too 🫧
Put on one song you like 🎵
Open a window for one minute 🪟
Have a small snack — anything counts 🍪
Stretch your arms up high, like me 🙆
Step outside for two minutes of daylight ☀️
Tidy one small spot. Just one! 🧺
Take a 5-minute walk. Bring me a postcard? 🏞️
Make a simple meal for yourself 🥪
Write down one thing that went okay today ✏️
Send a 'thinking of you' to someone 💌
Dance to one song (badly is best) 💃
Plan one small nice thing for tomorrow 🗓️
